name: ndpi2bids
author: Raul R. Cruces @ Multimodal Imaging and Connectome Analysis (MICA) Lab
description: Converts a Hamamatsu NDPI whole-slide image to a BIDS-compliant microscopy dataset, generating the required JSON sidecar and updating participants metadata.

inputs.name: NDPI file path
inputs.description: Path to the raw Hamamatsu .ndpi file to convert.

inputs.name: BIDS root directory
inputs.description: Path to the root of the BIDS dataset. Will be created if it does not exist.

inputs.name: Subject ID
inputs.description: BIDS subject label, without the 'sub-' prefix (e.g., PX067).

inputs.name: Stain entity
inputs.description: BIDS stain entity label (e.g., AT8, DAPI, LFB).

inputs.name: BIDS suffix
inputs.description: BIDS filename suffix indicating acquisition modality (e.g., BF for brightfield, FL for fluorescence).

inputs.name: Session ID
inputs.description: BIDS session label, without the 'ses-' prefix.

inputs.name: Sample ID
inputs.description: BIDS sample entity label, without the 'sample-' prefix (e.g., NP24709).

inputs.name: Acquisition label
inputs.description: BIDS acquisition label, without the 'acq-' prefix.

inputs.name: Run index
inputs.description: BIDS run index (integer), without the 'run-' prefix.

inputs.name: Chunk label
inputs.description: BIDS chunk entity label, without the 'chunk-' prefix (e.g., A3).

inputs.name: Metadata JSON template
inputs.description: Path to a JSON template file for sidecar metadata. Overrides built-in defaults.

inputs.name: Convert to OME-TIFF
inputs.description: If set, convert the NDPI file to OME-TIFF using bfconvert before placing it in the BIDS tree.

inputs.name: Dry run
inputs.description: Print intended actions without writing any files or converting any data.

inputs.name: Force overwrite
inputs.description: Overwrite existing BIDS output files and sidecars if they already exist.

output-files.name: BIDS output directory
output-files.description: Root of the BIDS dataset populated by the conversion.

error-codes.description: Input NDPI file not found or unreadable.
BIDS output directory could not be created.
Output file already exists and --force was not set.
